z.$description: Stacking order. z.marking is always highest: nothing may occlude the overall classification banner.

raised.$description: Content lifted within its container, such as a dragged row.

sticky.$description: Sticky table headers and docked toolbars.

dropdown.$description: Select and combo box listboxes attached to a control.

popover.$description: Menus and popovers, which may open from inside a dialog.

marking.$description: Classification banners. Above every overlay, including dialogs and toasts.
